cues.en: Hey, it's Bruno here.
cues.zh: 嘿，我是 Bruno。

cues.en: Thanks a lot for taking care of little Timmy.
cues.zh: 謝謝照顧小 Timmy。

cues.en: He said he had a lot of fun with you, and he said that you're pretty cool.
cues.zh: 他說和你玩得很開心，還說你很酷。

cues.en: Anyway, let's get back to work.
cues.zh: 總之，回來工作吧。

cues.en: We have a big client here, big hospital client, and they've heard about machine learning and they're willing to invest some money in experimenting with machine learning and seeing if we can build a model
cues.zh: 有個大客戶，大型醫院，聽過機器學習，願意投資一些錢來實驗，看看能不能建立，

cues.en: for them that might help their doctors.
cues.zh: 幫助醫師的模型。

cues.en: They have some data on heart disease and they want to see if we can build a model that will be worthwhile to them.
cues.zh: 他們有一些心臟病資料，想看看能不能建立對他們有用的模型。

cues.en: So can you create a rapport for them?
cues.zh: 所以，能幫他們做份報告嗎？

cues.en: They're not very good with machine learning, so obviously the more information we can provide them and not make it too technical, the better it is.
cues.zh: 他們不太懂機器學習，所以提供越多資訊、又不過度技術化，越好。

cues.en: You can do that.
cues.zh: 你做得到。

cues.en: You're the best.
cues.zh: 你最棒了。

cues.en: All right, everybody.
cues.zh: 好，各位。

cues.en: We just came off from a really tough section which was Psychic Learn.
cues.zh: 剛結束很有挑戰性的 scikit-learn 章節。

cues.en: It was a lot to learn.
cues.zh: 有很多內容要學。

cues.en: We know that.
cues.zh: 我們知道。

cues.en: I remember when I first learned I could learn.
cues.zh: 還記得我第一次學 scikit-learn，

cues.en: It was extremely overwhelming.
cues.zh: 真的覺得負擔很大。

cues.en: It felt like I will never, ever understand the entire library.
cues.zh: 感覺永遠不可能理解整個函式庫。

cues.en: But as you saw, what Daniel does is he goes to the documentation.
cues.zh: 但你看到了，Daniel 會去讀文件。

cues.en: He searches Google.
cues.zh: 會搜尋。

cues.en: Any time he has questions, he looks for the answer.
cues.zh: 只要有疑問，就找答案。

cues.en: That's part of our skill.
cues.zh: 這是我們的技能之一。

cues.en: As programmers are.
cues.zh: 身為程式設計師，

cues.en: As data scientists, we're able to solve problems that other people might have difficulties with.
cues.zh: 以及資料科學家，能解決別人覺得困難的問題。

cues.en: We're problem solvers.
cues.zh: 我們是解決問題的人。

cues.en: So over this project, we're going to repeat what we did with Psychic Learn, but actually formalize
cues.zh: 所以，這個專案會重複 scikit-learn 做過的內容，但真正整理成，

cues.en: it inside of a project so that now we have the skills and the tools necessary for us to build models around real world problems.
cues.zh: 一個正式專案，讓我們具備必要技能與工具，為真實世界問題建立模型。

cues.en: And we're going to build it in a way that actually mimics real life work.
cues.zh: 會模擬實際工作的方式。

cues.en: So some of these reports are actual reports that Daniel and I have worked with before.
cues.zh: 所以，有些報告就是我和 Daniel 之前實際使用過的。

cues.en: And you can use these reports and this methodology to demonstrate to your future employers why they should hire you or.
cues.zh: 可以用這些報告與方法，向未來雇主展示為什麼該聘用你，或者，

cues.en: Use it in your current role as a template for any future problems.
cues.zh: 在目前工作中，把它們當作未來問題的範本。

cues.en: But we've got a lot to cover, so let's get started.
cues.zh: 不過，還有很多內容，開始吧。
